_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Snake Clann air {width}×{height} grìd.
Tha thu a' dol a dh'fhàgail snake {player_id}. Gluasaidhean dlùth: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (no w/s/a/d).
Amas: mair a dh'fhaidhle nas fhaide no bidh an nas fhaide agus faigh an àireamh as àirde (tearmann cuairtean {max_turns} cuairtean).

game_action.invalid_death: Bhàsaich Snake {player_id} air sgàth gluasad mì-dhligheach.

outcome.survived_win: Choimhead cluicheadair {player_id} beò; chaill a h-uile duine eile.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Bhàsaich na nathair uile aig an aon àm.
outcome.outlived: Bha an cluicheadair a' fuireach nas fhaide na gach fear eile.
outcome.turn_limit: Tha crìoch cas air a ruighinn - bidh an sgòr as fheàrr a 'buannachadh briseadh-dìcheil.
